title: Maximum Subarray
summary: Find the largest sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray.
algorithmSteps: Track the best sum ending at the current value.
Either extend the previous subarray or start a new one at the current value.
Keep the largest sum seen anywhere.

examples.explanation: The contiguous subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum.

edgeCases: An all-negative input returns its largest single value.
A one-value input returns that value.
The implementation rejects an empty array because the subarray must be non-empty.
